scope: Bounded M2 development mechanism experiment; one training seed, not final performance evidence
loss: Physical executed-action masked native flow MSE + 0.1 * unbounded binary MC value MSE
trainable: shared prefix residual adapter and value head only; original VLM/action expert frozen
sft_sampling: uniform task / successful train episode / decision
value_sampling: uniform task / train episode / decision, success and failure
flow_rng: explicit index-specific torch generator; normal noise and inverse-CDF Beta(1.5,1) time
padding: Hold last executed physical action before ALOHA/delta/normalization transforms; loss excludes unexecuted timesteps and nonphysical dimensions. Native suffix attention still sees the padded context.
checkpoint_rule: Fixed final update; no validation checkpoint selection

controls.w1: success SFT + value head; value encoding detached from shared adapter
controls.w2: same inputs/initialization/noise/schedule; value gradient enters shared adapter
controls.w0: Pure SFT update parity is an engineering control; complete sequential-head reference is reported separately when run

actor_evaluation.noise: unchanged per-scene M1 behavior noise seed
actor_evaluation.selection: First four declared validation scenes per task, fixed before training; development only

interpretation: First test whether the gradient intervention is real and preserves pre-RL action ability. Critic loss improvement alone does not establish improved RL signals or policy; M4 label-controlled policy updates and larger confirmation remain required.
